scope: Identified failures from the chat review and additional correction audit; not an assertion that every possible defect has been eliminated.

issues.finding: Crossed, unordered or nonfinite books could reach the original diagnostic arithmetic
issues.resolution: v2 full-book validation retained by supported v3; v1 preserved only for historical reproduction

issues.finding: NaN and coerced request timestamps could evade v2 freshness checks
issues.resolution: v3 requires exact positive integers, bounded duration and bounded paired midpoint skew

issues.finding: Saved sources lacked strict JSON, unique identity and URL/path association checks
issues.resolution: v3 validates duplicate keys, nonfinite values, exact venue endpoint, BTC identities, hashes and confined paths

issues.finding: Rejected plans could leave a successful process status
issues.resolution: v3 returns exit 1 on rejected rows or malformed input, with rejection evidence when possible

issues.finding: Separate historical accounting reused the production normalizer
issues.resolution: New stdlib-only parser independently reconstructs all 532 saved sources and 29 normalized groups; same author and same data source remain explicit

issues.finding: Independent audit wording overstated independence of authorship
issues.resolution: Consolidated current state and delivery explicitly distinguish separate calculation, separate parser and external author

issues.finding: Historical improvement and profit interpretation mixed periods, units and evidence strength
issues.resolution: Current state uses common capital and period, discloses negative alternatives and zero entries, rejects comparing unlike bootstraps/drawdowns and withdraws future-profit claims

issues.finding: Saved BTC residual exposure reduction could be read as newly earned profit
issues.resolution: Exposure and cash sizing correction is explicitly not realized profit; all 12 valid plans unchanged

issues.finding: Research analogues could be mistaken for certified replications or currently reconfirmed Ethena RWA/loan claims
issues.resolution: Classified as adaptations and the unconfirmed specific claim withdrawn from decision support; no such revenue entered strategy accounts

issues.finding: Existing altcoin pilot did not observe the BTC carry hypothesis
issues.resolution: Separate frozen 84-day BTC public shadow observer, with a separate schedule; first entry and actual outcomes are still future events

issues.finding: A new observer needed causal decisions, crash handling and explicit missing-data semantics
issues.resolution: Durable chained ledger, OS process lock, atomic status, raw-source verification, no late entry/exit retry, persistent errors, known/missing slots and censored outcomes

issues.finding: Current public quotes could be mistaken for actual fills or complete margin certification
issues.resolution: Book depth and current lot checks at entry/exit, separate USDT margin, costs and signed funding; labels retain unknown fills, actual liquidation and incomplete hours

issues.finding: Future positive net investor profit is not established
issues.resolution: Cannot be manufactured by a code correction; retain validated expected profit as null, gather prospective observations without retuning

issues.finding: Actual account fees, tax, conversion, execution and margin rules are unknown under public-only scope
issues.resolution: Use explicit modeled assumptions and preserve real_profit=null; no authenticated account access or orders

issues.finding: No independent external author or second-market source audit has occurred
issues.resolution: Do not claim that an external audit was completed; comply with user instruction to work alone
